title: Database OOM crash, no restart
alert: The shop shows 'Service unavailable' errors; the database container has stopped and isn't restarting.

truth.root_cause: api 2.3.2 introduced an analytics dashboard query that makes PostgreSQL exceed its 1 GB memory limit; the database was killed (OOM, signal 9) and the container has no restart policy, so it stays down.
truth.fix: Roll back api to 2.3.1, then start the database container. Long term: fix the query or give the database more memory and enable restart policy.
